blind_spots.what: which process writes the internal SSD
blind_spots.reason: Per-process disk counters of other users' and short-lived processes need root; the 2026-10-04 privileged sample put ~76% on our own short-lived processes, so the ssd-writes row names a cause only from DiagnosticReports disk-writes reports
blind_spots.would_catch_if: proc_pid_rusage disk counters of our own processes per tick, or a consented privileged sample

blind_spots.what: who holds the compressed and swapped memory
blind_spots.reason: Phase 1 samples machine counters only; a per-process footprint including compressed pages needs task_info of each process
blind_spots.would_catch_if: own-process footprints (phys_footprint) per tick, attributed like births

blind_spots.what: the parents of processes that live less than the 2 s window
blind_spots.reason: Births are attributed from the newborns still alive at the window's end; the PID counter counts every birth, so the attributed shares lean toward longer-lived children
blind_spots.would_catch_if: an exec event stream (endpoint security, root) or the design's 60 s newborn census on a storm

blind_spots.what: launchd job run counts, exits and hangs from the unified log
blind_spots.reason: The design's hourly launchctl dumpstate counters and the 6-hourly unified-log harvest are phase 2
blind_spots.would_catch_if: the hourly and 6-hourly passes of docs/system-doctor-design.md
